integrity: Finite rational arithmetic verifies sample sizes and parameters; infinite-family result rests on the complete analytic proof, not numerical tests. Exact full worldwide publication priority and independent audit are not established.
scientific_limitations: Only exact, noiseless single-coordinate controllability or observability for an otherwise unit-weight undirected cycle with one positive exceptional edge. Does not determine finite-horizon conditioning, sensor robustness or multi-defect behavior; prior spectral eigenvector formulas may lead to related consequences.
title: Exact all-vertex sensing resonances and a totient placement law on a one-defect diffusion ring
